user.title: Connect Haus cameras
user.description: In Haus, open any camera’s settings and choose Connect Home Assistant. Enter the one-time setup code. The default address works when Haus Hub runs on this Home Assistant host.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Haus cameras
reauth_confirm.description: Generate a new setup code in Haus to restore this camera-only connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Haus cameras and controls
reconfigure.description: In Haus, choose Connect Home Assistant to create a new one-time code. This can authorize the supported controls of native camera bridges. Existing camera and entity identities stay unchanged.

error.invalid_auth: This setup code is invalid or expired. Generate a new code in Haus.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Haus Hub. Check the address, network and add-on version.

abort.already_configured: This Haus Hub is already connected.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Haus cameras and controls were reconnected.
